title: Site alert
overview: One full-width sitewide notice near the top. Do not stack.
apply_when: An incident or sitewide message that is not form validation.
not_when: In-page alert, toast, error summary, or official .gov HTTPS banner.

role.overview: One full-width sitewide notice near the top.
role.apply_when: An incident or sitewide message that is not form validation.
role.not_when: In-page alert, toast, or .gov HTTPS banner.

role.overview: The strongest sitewide notice. Still one — do not stack.
role.not_when: A second site alert under the first.

composition.overview: One site alert. Do not stack.
composition.not_when: Two banners of the same kind.

state.overview: Gone for this session if dismiss is allowed.
state.not_when: An emergency they cannot bring back when they still need it.

accessibility.overview: The banner has a name and a message.
accessibility.not_when: A colored strip with no text.

accessibility.overview: If it appears after load, it is announced.

keyboard.overview: Actions inside are reachable. The banner is not a trap.
